title: On the effect of higher order symmetry energy corrections in Skyrme models for neutron star matter
summary: Neutron stars consist of cold, dense, neutron-rich nuclear matter under charge neutrality and $β$-equilibrium. In most nuclear equation of state (EOS) studies, the isospin dependence of asymmetric nuclear matter is described using the conventional quadratic/parabolic approximation to the nuclear symmetry energy. However, its validity in the highly neutron-rich inner core of neutron stars remains uncertain.
